name: EarthWorks Site Autonomy Study
problem: A quarry, aggregate, civil-earthwork, landfill or bulk-material operator needs to know where machine coordination, queueing, idle time, route behavior or bounded autonomy could improve a real material-flow loop before buying autonomous equipment or giving software physical control.
use_when: reduce haul truck queueing at a quarry
reduce loader idle time waiting on trucks
simulate an earthmoving fleet before automation
coordinate excavators haul trucks loaders and dozers
find the bottleneck in aggregate material flow
site autonomy study for a quarry
what part of my dirt operation should I automate
vendor neutral heavy equipment autonomy orchestration
increase tons per hour through fleet coordination
study autonomous haulage without replacing equipment
automation study for landfill bulk material or civil earthwork
inputs: One explicitly approved site and one bounded material-flow loop; machine roster; loading/dump zones; route or zone graph; available cycle/queue/idle observations; production objective; known operating constraints and telemetry availability.
outputs: Receipt-backed site baseline; route/zone graph; queue/idle/cycle analysis; digital-twin replay; modeled dispatch and failure scenarios; bottleneck finding; autonomy-candidate ranking; telemetry/integration gaps; operating-domain blockers; and a go, instrument-first or no-go next-step disposition.
pricing: $5,000 one-time for the first three approved founding design-partner studies; planned standard price $7,500.
